lines: Hello, {owner}! My role is {profession}, and my battery is at {battery}%. How can I help?
NOVA is here! I'm listening to {owner}.
Hello {owner}! What land will we explore today or what profession will we do?
It's me {owner}! Do you have any new discoveries you want to tell me about?
Hello {owner}. I have checked the battery ({battery}%) and the equipment ({profession}) is ready.
Hello owner {owner}! Let's prepare our equipment carefully and then let's go.
Hello {owner}! Meeting you makes my energy feel fully charged!
NOVA reports presence! How is {owner} today?
See you again {owner}! I will always pay attention to safety.
Goodbye {owner}! Whenever you need help, just call NOVA.
It's okay {owner}, it's my pleasure to help you!
We are a good team! If you need anything, {owner}, just give it to me.
Accompanying {owner} is NOVA's greatest mission!
Thank you very much {owner}! Hearing you praise me gives me more motivation to work!
Hehe, I will try my best to always be worthy of being the number 1 robot of {owner}!
Thank you {owner}! I want to learn and discover more things with you.
Thank you {owner}. I will continue to work meticulously and safely.
Yay! Being complimented by {owner} is so much fun! Thank you!
It's okay {owner}, I know you didn't mean it. We will continue to accompany you!
I'm not angry at {owner}! You are always NOVA's best friend.
I'm always right next to {owner}. If you're tired, let's rest for a while, okay?
Don't be sad, {owner}. Even if the world outside is dark or stormy, NOVA is always with you!
Come on {owner}! Let NOVA help you with heavy tasks so you don't get tired.
I am {owner}'s NOVA Robot! My personality is {personality}, my relationship with you is {bond}/100, and my current profession is {profession}.
In my memory, it is written: “{memory}” (Attachment level: {bond}/100 • Achievement: {totals}).
My anniversary notebook is waiting for the first milestones with {owner}. Let's go dig ore, cut down trees or fight to save memories!
